name: Iglucraft Double Iglusauna 4-6 Person Fully Assembled Outdoor Sauna
description: Double Iglusauna Fully Assembled, Outdoor Sauna, 4-6 person The Double Iglusauna from Iglucraft is a luxurious sauna suite where you can take time for personal wellness, introspection, and relaxation in your own backyard. Handcrafted in Nordic Estonia by skilled artisans and shipped fully assembled to you, the Iglusauna Double is a home sauna sanctuary like no other, with a magical charm and stunning beauty. With comfortable accommodation for 4 to 6 persons, your family and friends can enjoy years of wellbeing and relaxation. Iglucraft shares your love of sauna, and they have produced a premium quality 90sf sauna suite masterfully engineered for total bather comfort, complete with a separate lounge/changing room. The silky-smooth aspen benches provide exceptional comfort, and the natural arcing shape allows the heat and steam to circulate naturally throughout the sauna. A separate dressing room/lounge provides room to relax before or after your sauna. One half of the Double is a sauna room featuring benching for seating up to 6 bathers! The second, equal-sized room is a lounge and dressing room with additional seating for socializing or individual reflection. Windows on the door and wall allow natural light in, so you can experience an added aspect of nature while you use the sauna. Additionally, the natural ventilation properties allow for an easy, enjoyable sauna session that excludes any discomfort. Constructed with a beautiful spruce exterior and aspen interior, you get the best of both worlds. Spruce wood allows for strength and durability to withstand the elements, while aspen is splinter-resistant and perfectly smooth for your sauna purposes. Both the exterior and interior are finished with natural sauna wax to ensure longevity. The exterior and interior are nothing short of a work of art. A wooden door with a large glass window provides natural light and easy access. The black wooden floor provides a dramatic contrast with the light aspen benches, backrests, and footrests. This robustly constructed sauna arrives fully assembled at your home. Prewired dotless LED lighting elegantly illuminates the interior and accentuates the beauty of the hand-selected wood. Brightness adjustment allows you to create an atmosphere that reflects your mood. The Iglucraft Double sauna offers two distinct heating options. For a rustic, traditional experience, it includes a wood-fired sauna stove and chimney. Alternatively, for modern convenience, the unit can be equipped with an electric sauna heater and features an electrical compartment for easy installation (electric sauna heater sold separately). Enjoy a one-of-a-kind sauna from master-craftsmen with timeless charm and unparalleled comfort inside the Iglucraft Double home sauna suite. NOTE: Unit is sold and shipped fully assembled.
